text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting North York Community Council to authorize the installation of all-way stop control at the intersection of Mildenhall Road and Dawlish Avenue. The installation of an all-way stop control is justified and recommended to clearly establish right-of-way and to enhance pedestrian and vehicular safety.
North York Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way stop control at the intersection of Mildenhall Road and Dawlish Avenue.
